scenes.heading: Private voice audition A
scenes.text: Why does the Moon look like a crescent, when it is still a round world? Watch the light. The Moon shines by reflecting sunlight. At first quarter, half the visible disk is bright. First quarter means one quarter of the way through the phase cycle.
